title: Towards Healthy AI: Large Language Models Need Therapists Too
reasoning: The paper defines 'Healthy AI' as safe, trustworthy, and ethical. It introduces the SafeguardGPT framework which includes an 'AI Critic' agent to evaluate the quality and ethicality of AI-human conversations. It specifically measures and aims to correct for harmful behaviors such as manipulation, gaslighting, and narcissism to align the AI with human values and ethical standards.
